query: select schemaname,tablename,indexname,indexdef from pg_indexes where schemaname='public' and tablename in ('lf_profile_selection_registry_v1','lf_profile_selector_policy_v1','lf_skill_selector_policy_v1','lf_skill_selection_registry_v1','lf_skill_catalog_v1') order by tablename,indexname;

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lf_profile_selection_registry_v1_pkey ON public.lf_profile_selection_registry_v1 USING btree (profile_code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lf_profile_selector_policy_v1_pkey ON public.lf_profile_selector_policy_v1 USING btree (profile_code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lf_skill_catalog_v1_pkey ON public.lf_skill_catalog_v1 USING btree (skill_code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lf_skill_selection_registry_v1_pkey ON public.lf_skill_selection_registry_v1 USING btree (skill_code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lf_skill_selector_policy_v1_pkey ON public.lf_skill_selector_policy_v1 USING btree (profile_code, skill_code, required_operation)
